full_prompt_en: A square monochrome ink-and-wash portrait shows a stern bald man from the shoulders upward, his head tipped down and turned slightly toward the left. The background is mostly raw white paper, with faint gray construction marks and pale square washes close to the head. His brow and eyes form a nearly continuous black shadow band, making the gaze difficult to read but forceful. Below it, the nose, cheekbones, and mouth are built from hard-edged gray facets, charcoal splashes, and thin sketch lines. His right hand rises at the lower center, holding a cigarette close to his lips. The visible fingers have angular knuckles and dark gaps between them; the cigarette cuts a pale diagonal across the dark mouth and hand. At the right, his ear and the loose collar of a light jacket are drawn with broken outlines and overlapping gray rectangles. Fine diagonal hatching and transparent wash patches leave parts of the skull unfinished, while dense black ink compresses the eye sockets and lower face. The portrait is cropped at the upper edge and below the shoulders, placing the large head close to the viewer. There is no discernible room, ground, or readable text. Light appears to come from the upper left, where the scalp and nose retain more paper white; the eye region and underside of the hand sink into thick shadow. The image balances exact facial structure with abrupt geometric interruptions and visible process marks. The overall composition feels tense and introspective, with black, gray, and white arranged in a compact field of fractured planes.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色水墨肖像描绘一名神情严肃的秃头男子，肩部以上入画，头低垂并略向左转。背景多为原白纸，头旁有浅灰结构笔痕和淡方形洗色。眉与眼几乎连成一道黑影，使目光难以读清却有力度。其下方的鼻子、颧骨和嘴由硬边灰色切面、炭黑泼痕和细草图线构成。他的右手在下方中央抬起，将一支香烟举近嘴唇。可见手指有棱角分明的指节，指间有深色空隙；香烟斜斜划过暗色嘴部和手部。右边的耳朵与浅色外套松领由断续轮廓和重叠灰色矩形画出。细斜排线与透明洗色让部分头骨保持未完成，密实黑墨则压住眼窝和下半张脸。肖像在上缘和肩下裁切，把大幅头部推近观者。没有可辨房间、地面或文字。光似从左上来，头顶与鼻梁保留较多纸白；眼部和手下方沉入厚影。图像以骤然的几何中断和可见过程笔痕平衡准确面部结构。整体构图紧张内省，在紧凑区域里把黑、灰、白排成碎裂平面。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome ink-and-wash image combines raw white paper, charcoal-black pools, transparent gray stains, and angular geometric fragments. Fine construction lines remain visible beneath broad hard-edged tonal planes. Concentrated dark bands create the focal weight, while pale incomplete edges open into generous negative space. Diagonal hatching and irregular splashes interrupt smoother modeled passages. Strong upper-side illumination is suggested by untouched white areas, with shadows merging into solid black. The shallow composition stays close to the picture plane; overlapping squares and broken contours provide a fractured rhythm without conventional depth. The finish is restless, graphic, and visibly hand-worked.
style_prompt_zh: 单色水墨图像结合原白纸、炭黑墨池、透明灰色洇痕和带棱角的几何碎片。细结构线在宽阔硬边明暗平面下仍可见。集中的深色带形成视觉重心，浅淡未完成的边缘则通向充裕留白。斜排线和不规则泼痕打断较平滑的塑形色段。未着墨的白区暗示强烈上侧光，阴影融成纯黑。浅空间贴近画面平面；重叠方块和断裂轮廓提供碎片化节奏，而不依靠常规纵深。成品躁动、图形化，手工过程清晰可见。
theme_en: A stern man holding a cigarette in a fragmented ink portrait
theme_zh: 碎片化水墨肖像中手持香烟的严肃男子
name: Yoji Shinkawa
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
